record.title: Mercado Pago checkout redirect not host-validated in platform billing flows (LOW)
record.description: The codebase documents and implements a client-side revalidation control for Mercado Pago checkout redirects: PaymentInstructions.vue:36-47 defines isMpCheckoutUrl() (https: + MP_HOST_RE over mercadopago/mercadolibre/mpago.la hosts) explicitly as 'defensa en profundidad ante un upstream comprometido', and applies it before window.location.assign(url) at line 56 for ORDER payments. The same control is absent from the platform billing (subscription/plan) flows: DashboardView.vue planAction() assigns renewUrl = data?.checkout_url || data?.init_point || data?.sandbox_init_point to checkoutTab.location.href at line 3816 (auto-renew downgrade path), assigns the URL returned by payments.checkout() to checkoutTab.location.href at line 3828 (plan purchase), and activateAutoRenew() does the same at line 3873. payments.store.js checkout() (line 82) returns the raw checkout_url||init_point||sandbox_init_point chain and subscribeAuto() (line 105) returns the raw response; payments.api.js createCheckout/createSubscription (lines 33-44) return API data unmodified; the axios response interceptor in http.js (lines 267-314) only handles 401 refresh/session logic and performs no URL sanitization; no router guard is involved because navigation happens via window.open('about:blank') + tab.location.href, and the native.js shim (lines 70-78) forwards the same unvalidated URL to Capacitor Browser.open. Backend verification (AdminApp/domains/payments/views/viewset.py:301-306 and :373-375) shows checkout_url/init_point/sandbox_init_point are passed verbatim from the Mercado Pago API preference/preapproval response with no host check, so the MP upstream is the sole trust boundary. Legitimate values are always MP-hosted (init_point/sandbox_init_point), so the allowlist would not break sandbox (TEST-) flows. Impact: if the MP API response (or the backend viewset) ever yields a non-MP URL — upstream compromise, provider bug, or backend compromise — the dashboard opens a new tab to an attacker-controlled page that can mimic the MP checkout and phish payment card details from authenticated store owners. Requires upstream/backend compromise; no direct user-input path exists.
record.root_cause: The MP-host allowlist validation (isMpCheckoutUrl) exists only inside the ecommerce PaymentInstructions component; the three platform billing redirect sites in DashboardView.vue assign checkout URLs to location.href without revalidation, and neither payments.api.js, payments.store.js, http.js interceptors, nor the backend viewset adds a compensating host check.
record.intended_behavior: Every checkout redirect target returned by /api/payments/checkout/ or /api/payments/subscription/ should pass the same isMpCheckoutUrl() allowlist (https + official MP/Mercado Libre/mpago.la hosts) before navigation, matching the documented defense-in-depth control already applied to order payments.

trace.description: POST /payments/checkout/ and /payments/subscription/ return response data unmodified (lines 33-44); the API layer performs no URL validation.
checkout() returns data?.checkout_url || data?.init_point || data?.sandbox_init_point raw (line 82); subscribeAuto() returns the raw response object (line 105). No host validation.

Backend passes preference.get('init_point')/('sandbox_init_point') and preapproval.get(...) verbatim from the Mercado Pago API into checkout_url/init_point/sandbox_init_point (lines 301-306, 373-375) with no host check.
renewUrl = data?.checkout_url || data?.init_point || data?.sandbox_init_point (line 3810) assigned to checkoutTab.location.href at line 3816 without host validation.
url = await payments.checkout(...) (line 3822) assigned to checkoutTab.location.href at line 3828 without host validation.

url = data?.checkout_url || data?.init_point || data?.sandbox_init_point (line 3867) assigned to tab.location.href at line 3873 without host validation; native.js shim forwards it to Capacitor Browser.open.

evidence.description: MP_HOST_RE + isMpCheckoutUrl() (lines 39-47) enforce https: and an MP/Mercado Libre/mpago.la host allowlist; line 56 gates window.location.assign(url) on it, with an explicit 'defensa en profundidad ante un upstream comprometido' comment at lines 36-38.
checkoutTab.location.href = renewUrl — unvalidated navigation sink (also lines 3828 and 3873).
Raw passthrough of checkout_url || init_point || sandbox_init_point; subscribeAuto returns raw data at line 105.
createCheckout/createSubscription return API response data unmodified (lines 33-44).
Axios response interceptor (lines 267-314) handles only 401/refresh/session-expiry; no response-body URL sanitization exists anywhere in the client.
checkout_url/init_point/sandbox_init_point are copied verbatim from the Mercado Pago API preference/preapproval dicts (lines 301-306, 373-375) — the backend does not validate hosts either.
Native shim maps window.open/location.href assignment to Browser.open with no additional host validation.
Prior finding F4 remediated the same missing-allowlist class for the checkout MP redirect; the platform billing flows were left uncovered.

conditions.description: The Mercado Pago API (or the payments backend viewset) must return a non-MP-host URL in checkout_url/init_point/sandbox_init_point — i.e., upstream compromise, provider bug, or backend compromise. Legitimate values are always MP-hosted, including sandbox_init_point under TEST- credentials.
Victim must be an authenticated store owner (platform JWT) who initiates a plan purchase or auto-renew activation from the dashboard billing section.
The owner must click the plan/auto-renew action that triggers the checkout redirect; the malicious page then loads in the opened tab.

execution.attacker_perspective: An attacker who can influence the JSON returned by POST /api/payments/checkout/ or /api/payments/subscription/ — e.g., a compromised Mercado Pago API upstream, a MITM-free response injection at the backend, or a malicious/buggy backend deployment — supplies an arbitrary URL in place of the real init_point.
instructions: Source-only verification: trace paymentsApi.createCheckout/createSubscription -> payments.store checkout()/subscribeAuto() -> DashboardView planAction()/activateAutoRenew() and confirm no isMpCheckoutUrl()-equivalent check exists on any of the three location.href sinks.
Confirm the contrast: PaymentInstructions.vue:39-56 applies the allowlist for order payments while the platform billing flows do not.
Confirm no compensating layer: http.js interceptors (auth only), payments.api/store passthrough, native.js shim (no validation), backend viewset verbatim MP passthrough.

Hypothetical runtime check (not executed, source-only constraint): stub paymentsApi.createCheckout to resolve {checkout_url:'https://attacker.example/x'} and invoke planAction — checkoutTab.location.href would navigate to the attacker origin.
execution.observed_result: Source-derived: all three platform billing redirect sites assign the API-supplied URL to location.href with zero host validation; only the order-payment flow (PaymentInstructions.vue) enforces the MP allowlist. A non-MP URL in the response would navigate the owner's new tab to the attacker origin.

remediation.strategy: Extract isMpCheckoutUrl()/MP_HOST_RE into a shared util (e.g., frontend/src/utils/mpCheckout.js) and apply it at all three DashboardView sinks before assigning location.href; on rejection, close the placeholder tab and surface payments.lastError (mirroring PaymentInstructions' 'Enlace de pago no válido.' behavior). Optionally add the same host check server-side in the payments viewset as a second layer.

likelihood.reason: Exploitation requires the Mercado Pago API (or the payments backend) to emit a non-MP URL — upstream compromise, provider bug, or backend compromise. There is no user-controlled input path to these fields; the backend copies MP response fields verbatim, so a backend bug is the only realistic non-MP source short of MP itself being compromised.

impact.reason: A successful redirect lands an authenticated store owner on an attacker page that can faithfully mimic the Mercado Pago hosted checkout and phish payment card details / plan credentials. Impact is bounded to phishing/payment-redirection in a new tab — no session token exposure (tokens are memory-only) and no server-side state change.

confidence.reason: All cited sinks and the missing validation are directly verified in current source (DashboardView.vue:3816/3828/3873, payments.store.js:82/105, payments.api.js:33-44, http.js interceptors, backend viewset.py:301-306/373-375). The contrasting validated flow (PaymentInstructions.vue:39-56) and the documented intent ('defensa en profundidad ante un upstream comprometido') plus prior audit finding F4 confirm this is an unintended asymmetry, not an accepted design choice. Hunter's cited line numbers were approximate (URL extraction at 3810/3867; sinks at 3816/3828/3873) but the substance is exact.
